newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS TO AXE 105 JOBS AT PICTURE TUBES.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TO AXE 105 JOBS AT PICTURE TUBES.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it would cut 105 of the 195 jobs at its Eindhoven-based picture tube pilot factory this year.
"It is expected that compulsory redundancies are unavoidable, but it is not yet known how many people will be affected," Philips said in a statement.

It said Philips Display Components had reviewed the plant's activities and found there was insufficient outlook for suitable alternatives for the small-scale production discontinued at the plant last year.

It said the Eindhoven pilot factory would continue primarily to focus on picture tube testing, but added that the number of tests undertaken by the pilot plant had decreased over the years due to improvements in the product development process.
Philips Display Components is part of the Philips Components division.
